mintAuthority.summary: WMXN has six reviewed native issuer deployments on Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Ripio's issuer EOA directly holds MINTER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE on each native token, the 4-of-7 Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and the fixed-destination LimitedMinter is an additional native issuer facility where currently authorized. The separate LimitedMinterBridge burn/mint adapter and Celo representation are reviewed only in Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: Current native-scope review on 2026-08-16 found issuer EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b with MINTER_ROLE and immediate UUPS UPGRADER_ROLE on the six independent Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis deployments. The 4-of-7 Safe 0x2b839174fe62466067c22e2a4c8054071f9d8d68 remains DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the native routes; its current Ethereum read at block 25770925 returned the refreshed owner set recorded above. LatamStable.mint() has no intrinsic supply ceiling, so the native issuer posture remains unbounded. The separate fixed-destination LimitedMinter is retained only on its currently authorized native deployments. LimitedMinterBridge arbitrary-recipient bridge minting, daily limits, pause, BridgeDeposit/operator controls, and the Celo representation are intentionally excluded from Mint Authority and retained in bridgeRouteRisk. Supervision review (2026-08-08): wMXN has its own independent certification - Pablo Eduardo Soto, CPA (CPCECABA Vol. 275 Folio 153) reconciled 518,689 wMXN outstanding across six chains against MXN 937,364.13 in a Mexican bank account as of 2026-03-31 - so reserve evidence is attestation-backed. Reconciliation stays unknown because Ripio labels it the first attestation of wMXN collateral, the whitepaper's cadence language is permissive, and later-period certifications return 404. No prudential regime applies to the unnamed Ripio group affiliate that issues wFIAT.
